julie_csm: URGENT — OrionFinance SIG (bespoke) due in 72h. They say exports fail with intermittent 401s and they need KMS/HSM attestation + audit log sample for the questionnaire. Can we triage and confirm evidence we can provide?

sasha_cs: filing ticket now — CS-4679. Customer reports 401s when hitting /v1/sig/export and also a billing spike from retries. They need: CAIQ section + HSM attestation PDF + last 7 days of audit log lines for key usage.

roland_se: logged. can someone post a failing request id or x-request-id from their logs? that will help trace through the routing + auth layer.

julie_csm: attached snippet from customer (redacted):
```
POST /v1/sig/export HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"sig_id":"abc-123"}
Response: 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: 01GXQY8Z2T5P4JZQ8Y2A1
```

roland_se: thanks. that x-request-id hits our edge and then shows `auth: token invalid` in the auth service logs. sending query to logs: `logs query "x-request-id:01GXQY8Z2T5P4JZQ8Y2A1" --service=auth --since=72h` — cc @aurora_infra for KMS backend correlation.

aurora_infra: FYI the KMS/HSM audit log lives in vaulting-prod (separate bucket). I'll pull key-access events for the same timeframe. need the customer key alias (they use customer-managed key: projects/orion/keys/orion-prod). can julie confirm alias?

julie_csm: confirmed alias is projects/orion/keys/orion-prod. also they asked for attestation of HSM tamper/rotation for last 6 months.

securitybot: Per compliance runbook: HSM attestation exports require security review and must be delivered via secure share (S3 presigned with restricted IP + audit). See https://redwood.internal/security/hsm-attest. Marking CS-4679 as security-review-needed.

dwight_support: billing note — the spike looks like client retries from 13:00-13:20 UTC, ~6k failed attempts before token expired. might be related to automated SDK retry behavior. we should include cost impact numbers in the customer response.

roland_se: reproduced locally with their SDK config: set token to expire in 60s + aggressive retry => we see auth service reject after token refresh race. quick repro steps:
1) create short-lived token (60s)
2) start 5 parallel requests to /v1/sig/export with SDK backoff disabled
3) observe 401s and duplicate retries in logs

roland_se: temp mitigation: recommend they rotate to a long-lived token while we patch race; alternatively enable jittered backoff in the SDK (example):
```
const client = new Redwood({retryOptions:{maxRetries:3, baseDelayMs:200, jitter:true}})
```

julie_csm: Customer approved temporary token rotation. They still need HSM attestation + audit log sample by EOD tomorrow. Can security produce the attestation PDF and aurora export the audit lines redacted for PII?

aurora_infra: I can export audit log CSV with columns: timestamp, key_alias, operation, request_id, user_agent — will redact client IPs. will upload to secure share once security signs off. ETA: 10:00 UTC tomorrow.

securitybot: assigning to @security_lead for attestation sign-off. deliverable: HSM attestation PDF + chain-of-custody note. target: EOD tomorrow per customer ask.

roland_se: I'll prepare an internal log bundle (auth + edge + vaulting correlation) for Security review — will reference CS-4679. expect to drop into secure share before 09:30 UTC.

julie_csm: perfect. I'll update OrionFinance with repro details, temporary mitigation steps, and expected delivery times. please flag if timeline slips. :thumbsup:
